Retrieves the current shred version from gossip entrypoints and prints it.

# Purpose
This code defines a command handler named `shred-version` that queries the network entrypoints for the current shred version and prints it to standard output. The function [`shred_version_cmd_fn`](<#shred_version_cmd_fn>) creates an `fd_ipecho_client_t`, finds the `gossip` tile in `config->topo`, and initializes the client with the tile entrypoints. It then polls the client until it receives a shred version, or stops with an error if the request fails. The `fd_action_shred_version` object registers the command name, handler function, and a short description for use by the action framework.
